puzzle_type.name: Detective scene with multiple interacting clues

title: A Crunch in the Snow
question: Which bay holds the car that hit the lamp post?
facts_on_image: It snowed from 1 am until 3 am, then stopped.
At 2 am the night porter heard a crunch: a car clipped the lamp post by the entrance and left a smear of its paint on it. That car is still in the car park.
Every drive since 1 am left its own separate pair of tyre tracks, all still visible: softened by fresh snow if made while it was snowing, sharp if made after it stopped. Anything older is buried.

x_caption: Which bay holds the car that clipped the lamp post? Reply with the bay number and the clues that rule out the others.

solution.explanation: The yellow smear limits the culprit to the yellow cars (bays 1, 4, 5). A 2 am drive during the snowfall leaves its own softened pair: bay 1 has no tracks (never moved), bay 4 has only a sharp pair (arrived after 3 am; any 2 am departure would have left a softened pair, and the only softened pairs belong to bays 2 and 5). Bay 5 is the only yellow car with softened tracks. Bay 2 also has softened tracks but is red.
